Questions About Your Subscription

When will I be charged?

Your card is charged on the day your next order ships. You can see your next shipment date anytime in your Customer Account, and changes made before [X hours] of that date apply to the upcoming order.

Can I change how often my order ships?

Yes. Open the subscription you want to update, select Change frequency, and choose the interval that works better for you. The update applies from your next shipment.

Can I skip a shipment or pause for a while?

Both, in just a few clicks. Skip moves your next order to the following date, and Pause holds everything for as long as you choose — your routine will be here when you are ready.

What happens if my payment fails?

We will let you know by email and try the charge again. Add or update your card under Payment methods and your subscription continues on the next retry, with no need to reorder.

How do I cancel?

You can cancel anytime from your Customer Account — no phone call needed. [Confirm whether cancelling before the next charge date keeps the order from being processed.] If you change your mind later, you can reactivate the same subscription from your account.

How does the 365-Day Guarantee work?

Every order is backed by our 365-Day Guarantee. [Add the return terms here: what is covered, how a refund is requested, and whether the product needs to be returned.]
